examples.arabic: بعد شهور من الجهد والاجتماعات المكثفة اقترب موعد اليوم المنتظر بفارغ الصبر
examples.english: After months of intense effort and meetings, the eagerly awaited day approached.
examples.transliteration: Ba'da shuhour min al-juhd wal-ijtima'at al-mukaththafah iqtaraba maw'id al-yawm al-muntazar bi-farigh al-sabr.

examples.arabic: شعرت ليلى ببعض الارتياح، إذ تذكرت أن تقديم القهوة العربية قبل الاجتماعات الرسمية يبعث على الهدوء.
examples.english: Layla felt some relief, as she remembered that serving Arabic coffee before official meetings instills calmness.
examples.transliteration: Sha'arat Layla bi-ba'd al-irtiyah, idh tadakkarat anna taqdim al-qahwah al-'arabiyyah qabla al-ijtima'at ar-rasmiyyah yab'athu 'ala al-hudu'.
